id: 1998-埃塞俄比亞-厄立特里亞戰爭

battle.name: 埃塞俄比亞-厄立特里亞戰爭
battle.brief: 1998年5月，埃塞俄比亞與厄立特里亞因邊界爭端在巴德梅地區爆發武裝衝突，雙方動員大量正規軍與重裝備，展開激烈的地面與空中對抗。這場戰爭的焦點之一是埃塞軍的T-55主力戰車，其在蘇聯時期大量裝備，並在衝突中發揮重要作用。

kit.name: T-55主力戰車
kit.history: T-55是蘇聯第二代中型戰車，設計用於提供可靠的火力與裝甲支援，於冷戰期間大量裝備蘇聯及受援國家，成為地面部隊的主力裝甲平台。

countries: 一九九八年五月的交戰雙方是埃塞俄比亞聯邦民主共和國與厄立特里亞國。厄立特里亞自一九九六年占領提格雷的梅克爾與巴德梅後，於一九九六至一九九七年向阿斯馬拉方向維持前進陣地；到一九九八年五月，它仍控制邊境縱深及數條深入埃塞俄比亞的公路。埃塞俄比亞從首都、提格雷與阿姆哈拉調集師旅部隊，在約一千公里的接觸線上把主力集中於扎蘭貝薩、措羅納與巴倫圖。五月十四日，埃塞俄比亞軍沿扎蘭貝薩－巴德梅－阿迪格拉特、措羅納－謝加－阿法貝特，以及巴倫圖－納克法等方向發動攻勢，海岸與馬薩瓦方向則受到牽制。厄立特里亞軍依邊境工事逐次抵抗；五月二十一日阿法貝特失守，阿格達特與納克法等據點相繼易手。五月三十日埃塞俄比亞軍進入阿斯馬拉；五月三十一日厄方宣布撤出埃塞俄比亞領土，六月三日接受阿爾及利亞斡旋的停火，戰線於數日內從追擊轉為脫離。
countriesEn: The belligerents in May 1998 were the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia and the State of Eritrea. After Eritrea occupied Mekelle and Badme in Tigray in 1996, it maintained forward positions toward Asmara during 1996 and 1997; by May 1998, it still controlled the border depth and several roads extending deeply into Ethiopian territory. Ethiopia concentrated divisional and brigaded formations from the capital, Tigray, and Amhara against a contact line approximately 1,000 kilometres long, concentrating its main strength around Zalambessa, Tsorona, and Barentu. On 14 May, the Ethiopian army attacked along the Zalambessa-Badme-Adigrat, Tsorona-Shega-Afabet, and Barentu-Nakfa axes, while the coastal and Massawa directions were subjected to pressure rather than receiving the principal breakthrough. Eritrean troops resisted in succession from prepared border positions. Afabet fell on 21 May, and Agordat, Nakfa, and other strongpoints subsequently changed hands. Ethiopian forces entered Asmara on 30 May. On 31 May Eritrea announced its withdrawal from Ethiopian territory, and on 3 June it accepted an Algerian-brokered ceasefire, shifting the front within days from pursuit to disengagement.
people: 作戰的政治與軍事中樞分別落在埃塞俄比亞總理兼武裝部隊最高指揮官梅萊斯·澤納瓦，以及厄立特里亞總統伊薩亞斯·阿夫韋爾基。澤納瓦作出全面反攻的政治決定，並承擔收回提格雷的軍事責任；參謀長塔斯坎·格布雷滕薩負責把決定轉成集團軍作戰、部隊配置與後勤優先序。厄方由國防部長阿里·賽義德·阿卜杜拉主持軍政防禦，與各邊防地段指揮部維持縱深調動。兩位領導人都經歷過游擊戰與建軍，因此邊境內一條公路或一個前進陣地都具有直接軍事意義。五月中旬中央突破形成後，阿法貝特等道路樞紐是由多支部隊包圍、側擊和封鎖後奪取，並非由單一突擊隊強攻；同一作戰鏈使阿格達特與納克法相繼被切斷。厄方在縱深受損後，把仍能控制的海岸與馬薩瓦方向留作退路；埃軍則因阿斯馬拉已撤守而於五月三十日進城。六月初，阿爾及利亞外交人員與聯合國特使萊蓋塞·特梅推動談判，六月三日達成停火安排。
peopleEn: The political and military centres of the campaign lay with Ethiopian Prime Minister and commander-in-chief Meles Zenawi and Eritrean President Isaias Afwerki. Zenawi made the political decision for a full counteroffensive and assumed responsibility for recovering Tigray. Chief of Staff General Tsadkan Gebretensae translated that decision into group operations, force allocation, and logistics priorities. On the Eritrean side, Defence Minister Ali Said Abdella directed the military-defensive arrangements and maintained depth movements with the sector commands. Both leaders had experience in guerrilla warfare and army building, giving a road or forward position inside the border direct operational significance. After the central breach formed in mid-May, road junctions such as Afabet were taken through encirclement, flanking movement, and isolation by several formations rather than through an assault by a single strike force. The same operational chain subsequently cut off Agordat and Nakfa. With its depth compromised, Eritrea retained the coast and Massawa direction as an avenue of withdrawal. Because Asmara had been evacuated, Ethiopian forces entered it on 30 May. In early June, Algerian diplomats and United Nations envoy Legesse W. Teme promoted negotiations that produced a ceasefire arrangement on 3 June.
kits: 一九九八年可確認投入的裝備中，雙方地面部隊以T-55與部分T-62系列戰車為主，輔以BMP-1式裝甲步兵車、AKM與AK-74步槍、PKM或DShK班機槍及RPG-7反裝甲武器。埃塞俄比亞把D-30式122公厘牽引榴彈砲與BM-21式122公厘多管火箭砲集中使用，厄立特里亞防線也部署了牽引火砲、反戰車武器與封鎖器材。T-55使用的100公厘砲彈、T-62使用的115公厘砲彈、D-30的122公厘榴彈以及BM-21的122公厘火箭彈分屬不同供應鏈，後方必須分別儲運。埃塞俄比亞航空方面使用MiG-21、MiG-23與Su-27執行偵察、對地攻擊及武裝巡邏，Mi-8則負責運兵與後送；厄方航空任務有限，地面防空包括ZU-23-2與ZSU-23-4等大口徑自動砲。物資由阿的斯亞貝巴經德西、默克萊送往提格雷前線，火砲藥、燃料、備件與搶修車隊共同決定縱深突進速度；厄方則依阿斯馬拉、巴倫圖與馬薩瓦的公路網調度。雙方都沒有公開且可核對的彈藥存量，因此不能把任何發射任務的實際基數寫成確定數字。
kitsEn: Among the equipment confirmed as available in 1998, the principal ground fighting vehicles of both sides were T-55 and some T-62-series tanks, supported by BMP-1 armoured infantry vehicles, AKM and AK-74 rifles, PKM or DShK squad machine guns, and RPG-7 anti-armour weapons. Ethiopia concentrated D-30 122 mm towed howitzers and BM-21 122 mm multiple rocket launchers, while the Eritrean line also employed towed artillery, anti-armour weapons, and obstruction materials. The 100 mm ammunition used by T-55, the 115 mm ammunition used by T-62, D-30 122 mm artillery rounds, and BM-21 122 mm rockets belonged to separate supply chains and had to be stored and transported separately. The Ethiopian air arm used MiG-21, MiG-23, and Su-27 aircraft for reconnaissance, ground attack, and armed patrols, while Mi-8 helicopters transported troops and provided support. Eritrean air operations were limited, and its ground air defence included automatic guns such as the ZU-23-2 and ZSU-23-4. Supplies moved from Addis Ababa through Dessie and Mekelle to the Tigray front. Artillery ammunition, fuel, spare parts, and repair convoys together determined the speed of the deeper advances. Eritrea organised movement along the road network connecting Asmara, Barentu, and Massawa. Neither side published a verifiable ammunition inventory, so the actual inventory for any firing mission cannot be stated as a confirmed figure.
tactics: 五月十四日的突破作戰並非戰車直接長距離衝鋒。埃塞俄比亞先以火砲和BM-21火箭砲對邊境陣地實施砲火準備，再由工程部隊處理地雷、鐵絲網與反坦克壕，闢出數條有限通道；步兵沿通道清除射擊孔和據點，T-55與T-62則利用坡地遮蔽，以直瞄火力支援，並在步兵鞏固陣地後向前推進。厄立特里亞以縱深堡壘、交叉射界和預備隊組織防禦，步兵與少量裝甲在陣地間實施局部反擊，使中央突破口不斷擴大而不立即崩潰。突破形成後，埃軍利用相鄰方向實施側翼運動，而不是把全部力量壓在同一正面。阿法貝特失守後，阿斯馬拉至馬薩瓦及中部公路網受到切斷，厄方預備隊即使奪回局部位置，也無法重新連成一條完整防線。五月下旬，埃塞俄比亞由北、中、西數個方向並行壓縮阿格達特、納克法與阿斯馬拉周圍的據點；厄軍在封鎖線完全合攏前主動撤往馬薩瓦及海岸方向，因而避免主力被包圍。埃軍追擊速度仍受長距離公路、燃料與彈藥運送限制；六月五日停火生效後，前線活動隨之停止。
tacticsEn: The operation launched on 14 May was not a direct long-range charge by tanks alone. Ethiopia first conducted artillery preparation with field guns and BM-21 rocket launchers against the border positions. Engineer troops then dealt with minefields, wire obstacles, and anti-tank ditches to open a limited number of passages. Infantry cleared firing positions and strongpoints along those passages, while T-55 and T-62 tanks used defilade and direct fire to support them, advancing only after infantry had secured the ground. Eritrea organised its defence in depth with fortified positions, intersecting fields of fire, and reserves. Infantry and limited armour conducted local counterattacks between strongpoints, preventing the central breach from collapsing immediately. Once the breach widened, Ethiopian formations made flanking movements across adjacent axes instead of committing every unit to the same frontal sector. After Afabet fell, the road network linking Asmara with Massawa and the interior was cut. Even where Eritrean reserves recovered local ground, they could not restore a continuous defensive line. In late May, Ethiopian columns compressed the positions around Agordat, Nakfa, and Asmara along northern, central, and western axes. Before the encirclement closed, Eritrean units withdrew toward Massawa and the coast, avoiding the destruction of the main force in a pocket. Ethiopian pursuit remained limited by long road networks and the transport of fuel and ammunition. Active movement stopped when the ceasefire took effect on 5 June.
data: 可核對的主要時間線如下：全面攻勢於五月十三日展開，五月十四日多路主力越過邊界；五月二十日前後，中央縱隊切斷阿斯馬拉通往馬薩瓦的主要道路。五月二十一日阿法貝特失守，之後數日內阿格達特與納克法相繼易手。五月二十八日，聯合國安全理事會通過第1197號決議，要求立即停止敵對行動並尋求政治解決。五月三十日，埃塞俄比亞軍進入阿斯馬拉；五月三十一日，厄立特里亞宣布將撤出埃塞俄比亞領土。六月三日，雙方接受阿爾及利亞提出的停火；六月五日停火生效，同日安全理事會通過第1207號決議，對兩國實施武器禁運。從全面交戰到停火實行不足四週。公開資料中的傷亡總計互相矛盾，缺乏能交叉核對的完整統計，因此不採用任何單一傷亡數字；較能確認的是沿線據點先後易手、出現戰俘與遺留裝備，以及阿斯馬拉至馬薩瓦的交通一度中斷。
dataEn: The principal verifiable timeline is as follows: the full-scale offensive began on 13 May, and multiple columns crossed the border on 14 May. Around 20 May, the central column cut the main road from Asmara to Massawa. Afabet fell on 21 May, and Agordat and Nakfa changed hands within the following days. On 28 May, the United Nations Security Council adopted Resolution 1197, demanding an immediate end to hostilities and a political settlement. Ethiopian forces entered Asmara on 30 May, and on 31 May Eritrea announced that it would withdraw from Ethiopian territory. On 3 June both sides accepted the Algerian ceasefire proposal. The ceasefire took effect on 5 June, when the Security Council also adopted Resolution 1207, imposing an arms embargo on both countries. Less than four weeks elapsed between full-scale fighting and implementation of the ceasefire. Public casualty totals conflict and lack a complete, cross-verifiable record, so no single casualty figure is used. The more firmly established facts are the successive loss of strongpoints, the presence of prisoners and abandoned equipment, and the temporary interruption of the road linking Asmara with Massawa.
cause: 這場戰爭的根源並非一九九八年五月才出現的一次接觸。厄立特里亞在一九六一至一九九一年的獨立戰爭後於一九九三年建國，但雙方始終沒有共同勘定並接受永久邊界。殖民時期留下的行政界線、非洲統一組織邊界委員會繪製的地圖，以及後續各方對地圖效力的解釋並不一致，巴德梅等據點因而成為軍事爭奪焦點。一九九六年五月，厄立特里亞攻入提格雷，占領梅克爾與巴德梅，並向阿斯馬拉方向推進，使兩國在邊境實力對比與阿斯馬拉周邊安全同時改變。埃塞俄比亞把收復提格雷視為必須完成的安全問題，厄立特里亞則把既有陣地視為防止邊界再被推移的堡壘。埃塞俄比亞還指稱厄方支援境內反政府武裝，厄方否認並反指埃方干預，這些指控加深了不信任，但公開紀錄不能把戰爭直接歸因於單一因素。一九九八年五月初，措羅納與扎蘭貝薩一帶的武裝衝突再度升高；埃塞俄比亞認定邊境陣地正在受損，決定以多路進攻一次突破，厄立特里亞則把集結視為入侵準備並加強防禦，原本的地方衝突因此擴大為國家間戰爭。
causeEn: The roots of the war did not begin with a single contact in May 1998. Following the Eritrean war of independence from 1961 to 1991, Eritrea became a state in 1993, but the two countries never jointly surveyed and accepted a permanent boundary. Colonial administrative lines, maps drawn by the Organization of African Unity boundary commission, and later differing interpretations of those maps remained inconsistent. Positions such as Badme consequently became military points of contention. In May 1996, Eritrea entered Tigray, occupied Mekelle and Badme, and advanced toward Asmara, changing both the military balance along the border and the security of the area around Asmara. Ethiopia regarded the recovery of Tigray as a security requirement. Eritrea regarded its existing positions as barriers against another movement of the border. Ethiopia also accused Eritrea of supporting armed opposition movements inside Ethiopia, while Eritrea denied this and accused Ethiopia of interference. These allegations deepened mistrust, but the public record cannot reduce the war to one cause. In early May 1998, armed clashes increased around Tsorona and Zalambessa. Ethiopia concluded that the border positions were being eroded and chose a multi-axis offensive to break them at once. Eritrea regarded the concentration of Ethiopian forces as invasion preparations and reinforced its defences. A local conflict consequently developed into a war between states.
impact: 六月五日停火生效時，埃塞俄比亞軍已在巴德梅、梅克爾、阿法貝特、阿格達特、納克法與阿斯馬拉等廣大地區建立控制，厄立特里亞則退守馬薩瓦、達赫拉克群島及相鄰海岸地帶。厄方確實撤出了埃塞俄比亞領土，但埃軍仍佔據厄立特里亞相當大的內陸地區，因此雙方都未回到一九九六年以前的實際控制線。聯合國第1207號武器禁運增加了合法補給與裝備補充的困難，也切斷了兩國原本有限的外來軍事供應；短期內，殘存火砲、戰車、燃料和維修能力因而更受重視。雙方都留下受損公路、消耗後的彈藥基數與失去的前進陣地，但沒有可靠資料支持精確計算裝備損失。六月停火後成立的軍事聯絡安排處理的是脫離、戰俘交換與武器清點，不是永久邊界劃定。聯合國也沒有立即建立完整的停火核查機制，該任務到二000年才正式部署。一九九九年，雙方又在巴德梅爆發戰鬥，證明一九九八年只處理了軍隊位置，沒有解決邊界爭議。
impactEn: When the ceasefire took effect on 5 June, Ethiopian forces had established control over broad areas including Badme, Mekelle, Afabet, Agordat, Nakfa, and Asmara, while Eritrea had withdrawn to Massawa, the Dahlak Islands, and adjacent coastal areas. Eritrea did withdraw from Ethiopian territory, but Ethiopian forces still occupied a substantial inland part of Eritrea, so neither side returned to the actual lines held before 1996. United Nations Resolution 1207 made legal resupply and replenishment of military equipment more difficult and cut off the limited foreign military supply available to both countries. In the short term, surviving artillery, tanks, fuel, and maintenance capacity therefore became more important. Both sides left damaged roads, depleted ammunition stocks, and lost forward positions, but reliable evidence does not permit an exact calculation of equipment losses. Military liaison arrangements established after the June ceasefire addressed disengagement, prisoner exchanges, and equipment inventories rather than a permanent boundary. The United Nations did not establish a complete ceasefire verification mechanism immediately; that deployment followed in 2000. Renewed fighting at Badme in 1999 demonstrated that the 1998 agreement had settled troop positions without resolving the boundary dispute.
result: 從作戰層面看，這是一場由埃塞俄比亞取得戰役成果、而厄立特里亞避免主力被包圍的戰爭。埃塞俄比亞收復提格雷，突破厄立特里亞經營多年的邊境防線，切斷通往阿斯馬拉與馬薩瓦的道路，並在五月底進入阿斯馬拉，因而達成此次反攻的主要軍事目標。厄立特里亞未能守住自一九九六年以來取得的大部分前進位置，但在發現中央與西側縱深即將被切斷後，組織退卻並保存成建制部隊，馬薩瓦與達赫拉克群島仍在其控制之下，所以這不是一場以全軍覆沒收場的戰役。六月五日停火後的交換安排包括戰俘返回、遺留裝備清點及前沿部隊脫離，主要前線維持到一九九九年才再度大規模破裂。埃塞俄比亞沒有在停火時撤出厄立特里亞內陸占區，厄立特里亞也沒有取得共同勘定的邊界線，兩國因此未簽下終止爭端的永久和平協議。停火確實終止了五月的追擊，但只是把未決的邊界、陣地與軍事對峙凍結在新的位置。
resultEn: At the operational level, this was a war in which Ethiopia achieved the campaign objectives while Eritrea avoided the destruction of its main army. Ethiopia recovered Tigray, broke through the border defence Eritrea had developed over several years, cut the roads leading toward Asmara and Massawa, and entered Asmara at the end of May. It therefore achieved the principal military purpose of the counteroffensive. Eritrea failed to retain most of the forward positions acquired since 1996, but after recognising that its central and western depth was about to be cut, it conducted an organised withdrawal that preserved formed units. Massawa and the Dahlak Islands remained under Eritrean control, so the campaign did not end in the destruction of its entire army. After the ceasefire of 5 June, arrangements included prisoner returns, inventories of abandoned equipment, and the disengagement of forward units. The principal front remained stable until large-scale fighting resumed in 1999. Ethiopia did not withdraw from its inland positions in Eritrea at the ceasefire, and Eritrea did not obtain a mutually surveyed border. The two states therefore concluded no permanent peace settlement ending the dispute. The ceasefire ended the pursuit of May, but it froze the unresolved border, territorial positions, and military confrontation at new locations.
